title: Light Brazilian Yellow Split Pea Wrap
description: A briny, snappy, and energizing Brazilian dish featuring yellow split peas, wrapped in a lotus leaf
instructions: Rinse the yellow split peas and soak them in water for 30 minutes.
Heat the coconut oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the soaked and drained yellow split peas, uncooked white rice, and khao khuat rice to the pan.
Cook for 10 minutes, stirring frequently, until the mixture is lightly toasted.
Season the mixture with salt to taste.
Lay a lotus leaf flat and place 1/4 of the pea and rice mixture in the center of the leaf.
Fold the leaf over the filling to form a wrap and repeat with the remaining ingredients.
Serve the wraps warm or at room temperature.
